_comment: The managed Chromium is driven by the agent and watched by a person. Its chrome follows the desktop surface; page colors remain the site's own. Password and autofill prompts stay disabled so they do not cover the page. New tabs open blank: Chromium's new-tab page embeds its own internal frames, and a blank tab is what a person watching expects. The Hotline extension, which answers passkey requests with keys kept in the computer's service, stays pinned to the toolbar. Its native messaging host is the one the image installs: a host file dropped in the browser profile, which any job can write, is not read.
